# Employee Data Analysis using SQL and Python

## Project Overview
This project analyzes an employee dataset stored in MySQL. Python, SQLAlchemy, and pandas were used to connect to the database and run SQL queries.

## Tools Used
- MySQL
- SQL
- Python
- Pandas
- SQLAlchemy
- PyMySQL
- Jupyter Notebook

## Dataset Columns
- Employee ID
- Employee Name
- Job Role
- Manager ID
- Hire Date
- Salary
- Commission
- Department Number

## Tasks Performed
- Connected MySQL with Python
- Retrieved employee records using SQL
- Filtered employees using IN, NOT IN, BETWEEN, LIKE, and NULL conditions
- Filtered data by job role, department, hire date, and commission
- Counted total employees and unique job roles
- Calculated total payroll
- Calculated maximum, minimum, and average salary

## Key Findings
- Total employees: 14
- Unique job roles: 5
- Total payroll: 29,025
- Average salary: approximately 2,073

## Conclusion
This assignment improved my SQL and Python data-analysis skills. I learned how to query employee data, apply filters, and calculate meaningful business metrics.
